title: Engagement That Sells: Influencer Video Advertising on TikTok
eligible_reason: Not screenable from the package and no evidence of a staggered binary design. The replication package contains no code and no data: the only file is a 'Replication Guide' (mksc.2021.0107.docx) stating that the software (MIT Case No. 25019, 'An algorithm that predicts the impact of video ads on sales') and its data are hosted in a private domain and are released only to academics who send a signed MIT Internal Research End User Agreement to [email removed]. The abstract describes a machine-learning algorithm predicting the effect of influencer video ads on sales; the difference-in-differences full-text flag most likely refers to a validation or robustness exercise, which cannot be inspected without the code or the article text.
design_notes: Unknown. Package_dir holds _archive_mksc.2021.0107.zip (26 KB) whose only payload is the docx guide plus a __MACOSX resource fork of a PDF that is not itself in the archive. The regression list data/packages/mksc.2021.0107_regressions.txt is empty. No README beyond the guide, no scripts, no data.
